name: codeport
displayName: CodePort — Navigate Markdown to Source Code
description: Bring source-code navigation to Markdown. Resolve symbols in code blocks and inline code through a CodeGraph code graph, read in-process with no language server.
author: rong baichuan

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodePort reads a CodeGraph index and opens source files. In an untrusted workspace codeport.codegraph.path is ignored, because CodePort imports the module that path points at.

virtualWorkspaces.description: CodePort needs a real file system to read a CodeGraph index and open source files.

codeport.definition.enabled.description: Enable go-to-definition (F12 / Ctrl+Click) for symbols inside Markdown code blocks and inline code.

codeport.references.enabled.description: Enable Find All References for symbols inside Markdown code blocks and inline code.

codeport.hover.enabled.description: Enable hover information (symbol kind, signature, definition site) inside Markdown code blocks and inline code.

codeport.codeLink.enabled.description: Turn `path/to/file.c:42` inside inline code into a clickable link that opens the file at that line.

codeport.codeLink.resolveRelativeToMarkd.description: Also resolve path links relative to the directory of the Markdown file itself (in addition to absolute paths and workspace-root-relative paths).

codeport.codegraph.path.markdownDescription: Path to an installed CodeGraph: the package directory, the SDK entry (`npm-sdk.js`), or the `codegraph` CLI. Empty = auto-detect (the project's `node_modules`, then the usual global prefixes).

codeport.trace.description: Log level for the CodePort output channel.
codeport.trace.markdownDescription: Log level for the CodePort output channel. `off` still reports warnings and errors.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
